title: The Nawab orders Taru Singh's scalp to be scraped

blocks.text: The Nawab promises favor and survival if Taru Singh will only convert, but Taru Singh asks instead for the strength to keep his faith and kes intact until death. His refusal transforms the hearing into an act of state violence against a visibly unyielding Sikh.

Furious at that answer, the Nawab ordered the barbers to shave off his sacred hair and break the sign of his discipline by force. When the barbers fail, the regime escalates further and calls for his scalp itself to be scraped away.
The page highlights both the cruelty of the punishment and Taru Singh's unwavering resolve under it. Mughal force grows harsher exactly because his faith cannot be shaken.
